# key, then the value; tab-separated; \\ is one backslash, \t a tab.
# Words whose bytes are what a quoting test holds to: a system's variable or path in them.
dollar-tab	$HOME\t'a'
dollar-space	$HOME 'a'
backslash-name	back\\slash
note-home	it's $HOME
apply-line-home	gragas promote 'a; rm -rf x' go.errors.2 --note 'it'\\''s $HOME' --apply
ps-dollar-backtick	$HOME`x`
ps-dollar-line	gragas gen -C '$HOME`x`'
a-b	a\\b
drive-dir	C:\\dir\\
drive-dir-line	gragas rule new --name 'C:\\dir\\'
